from pathlib import Path
import sys,json,hashlib
from fractions import Fraction as Q
root=Path('controlled_furrowing').resolve();sys.path.insert(0,str(root/'scripts'))
from quadratic_endpoint_observer import observe_state,add
from annulus_observer import serial
program=globals().get('program','Replay code retained in original receipt.')
sha=lambda p:hashlib.sha256(Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
diagnostics=json.loads((root/'evidence/quadratic_endpoint_observer_diagnostics.json').read_text())
checks={'observer_source_matches_synthetics':sha(root/'scripts/quadratic_endpoint_observer.py')==json.loads((root/'evidence/quadratic_endpoint_observer_synthetic.json').read_text())['source_sha256'],
        'observer_source_matches_diagnostics':sha(root/'scripts/quadratic_endpoint_observer.py')==diagnostics['source_sha256'],
        'all_eight_existing_cases_recorded':len(diagnostics['rows'])==8}
records=[]
for i,row in enumerate(diagnostics['rows']):
    path=root/row['file'];state=json.loads(path.read_text())
    variants={}
    for weight in ('current_radial_line','current_disk'):
        for aggregate in ('spatial_max','regional_mean'):
            out=observe_state(state,weighting=weight,component_aggregation=aggregate)
            variants[weight+'_'+aggregate]=out
            ep=out['four_endpoints'];mean=out['mean_alternatives'][weight]
            checks[f'case{i}_{weight}_{aggregate}_height_resolution']=out['maximum_shortening_certificate']['requested_width_achieved']
            checks[f'case{i}_{weight}_{aggregate}_mean_below_maximum']=ep['regional_mean_Eulerian_height_shortening'].hi<=ep['maximum_Eulerian_height_shortening'].hi
            checks[f'case{i}_{weight}_{aggregate}_mean_components_sum_to_mean_height']=add(mean['apical_regional_mean_downward'],mean['basal_regional_mean_upward'])==mean['height_regional_mean_shortening']
    checks[f'case{i}_static_maximum_independent_of_weight_and_component_variant']=len({(o['four_endpoints']['maximum_Eulerian_height_shortening'].lo,o['four_endpoints']['maximum_Eulerian_height_shortening'].hi) for o in variants.values()})==1
    checks[f'case{i}_current_input_hash']=sha(path)==row['sha256']
    records.append({'file':row['file'],'sha256':sha(path),'all_four_variants':variants})
checks={k:bool(v) for k,v in checks.items()}
receipt={'status':'PASS_SAVED_STATE_OBSERVER_REPLAY' if all(checks.values()) else 'FAIL','checks':checks,'records':records,
         'observer_source_sha256':sha(root/'scripts/quadratic_endpoint_observer.py'),'annulus_helpers_sha256':sha(root/'scripts/annulus_observer.py'),
         'source_contract_sha256':sha(root/'docs/JOINT-OBSERVATION-CONTRACT.md'),
         'verification_program':program,'scope':'Exact-observer numerical consistency on existing fields only; not an independent biological reference/ROI determination or source-time certificate.'}
(root/'evidence/quadratic_endpoint_observer_verification.json').write_text(json.dumps(serial(receipt),indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps({'status':receipt['status'],'checks':len(checks),'all_pass':all(checks.values())}))
assert all(checks.values())
